how: Each part row holds the manufacturer pin table (datasheet name per pad), the land-pattern numbers and the net each datasheet function must carry on this board. Expected nets were written from the datasheet function and the circuit intent (firmware pins.h for RP2040 GPIOs), then compared with design.json by pinout_check.py. PDFs are not committed; each datasheet is cited by URL and the SHA-256 of the PDF fetched on 2026-11-03. Rev G (2026-11-09): this file is ledger.json with the Rev G changes: J6 removed; the BNC centre pins and K4 pins 3 / 4 / 8 on the jack nets (JK_*); Q7 in the AO3400A row; rows for the TLP172AM, H4V5HD3B, H3V3LD5B and BAV99, whose PDFs were fetched again on 2026-11-09 and match the SHA-256 recorded in rev-g-protection/part-selection/parts.json. Run with --ledger validation/pinout-ledger/ledger-rev-g.json --package validation/rev-g.

limits: Checks pad numbering, pad geometry and nets against datasheet text and drawings read by a reviewer; tolerances flag gross land-pattern differences, not IPC fillet compliance. JLC orientation uses the EasyEDA record of the LCSC part, which is what JLC places from; the vendor placement preview remains the final check.

parts.cite: p.11 "2. Surface-mount terminal": SA type suggested mounting pad (top view) 1 x 2.94 pads, 2.54 pitch, 9.56 row centres; Schematic (Top view) 2-coil latching (Reset condition): coil 1(+) / 5(-) (open box), coil 10(+) / 6(-) (filled box); contacts in reset: 3-2 and 8-9 closed, 4 and 7 open; "Orientation (indicates PIN No.1) stripe" (p.12 packing)
notes: Coil polarity (+ on VRLY at pins 1 and 10, low-side switch on 5 and 6) and the contact map (range resistor on NO pins 4 / 7, closed only after SET) follow the drawing directly.

Which coil is SET is NOT printed in words: Panasonic draws the 1-5 coil open and the 6-10 coil filled in the "Reset condition" schematic, and no TQ document found states set/reset by pin number. The board (and prior audit RC-03) assume 1-5 = SET. If that reading were wrong the board still works with a firmware change (pulse the shared RESET line to set all four, then the per-relay lines to drop the unwanted ones), so this is not a board-dead risk. Bring-up: pulse RNG_SET_LO alone and confirm K1 closes (continuity SOURCE_BUF-RG100).
EasyEDA C2684450 pads are 1.2 x 3.3 at 10.16 mm rows (not the Panasonic 9.56); only used here for JLC orientation, where pad 1 lands on pad 1 within 0.3 mm.
Rev G: K4 COM2 (pin 8) on JK_HCUR and pole 1 (COM1 pin 3, NO1 pin 4) shorts JK_HCUR to JK_HPOT while K4 is set (rev-g-protection phase 7, the reference bypass).
attention: Set/reset coil identity (1-5 = SET) is read from Panasonic's open/filled coil drawing, not from a printed label; polarity and contact map are verified. Consequence if wrong: firmware change only (feature-recoverable). Confirm at bring-up: pulse RNG_SET_LO alone, K1 must close SOURCE_BUF-RG100.
